# House Of Horror (hhorror.taf) -- ADRIFT 3.90, 51,820 bytes, from
# https://www.adrift.co/files/games/hhorror.taf
# 36 rooms, 7 NPCs, 125 tasks, 46 events, 14 variables.  Max score 155.
#
# ***  DERIVED, NOT WRITTEN -- REGENERATE IT, DO NOT EDIT IT  ***
# `open door` on the Porch runs T0, whose twenty-one `ACT type=0 ... v2=1`
# actions each move one object to a **random room of a room group**.  Every
# key, tool and treasure in this game is therefore somewhere different in
# every RNG thread, and a hand-written route is worth exactly one thread.  So
# this file is generated:
#     python3 harness/hhorror_solve.py 1 > goldens/hhorror_solution.txt
# The solver replays the game after every command, reads the world out of the
# trace stream (SCR_TRACE_OBJ, SCR_TRACE_JUDY, SCR_TRACE_VARS=health) and
# re-orders the puzzle chain around wherever this seed's scatter put things.
# Roughly one seed in four is solvable at all; seed 1 is, and reaches the
# ceiling.  See the script's docstring for the rest.
#
# ***  BEST POSSIBLE IS 145/155 -- THE LAST 10 POINTS ARE AN AUTHOR BUG  ***
# The nine treasures are scored by T101-T109, each `RESTR type=0` on its own
# object with `v2=0` ("in room") and `v3=36` (room 35, "Home Free!") -- except
# **T109, the bag of doubloons, which has `v3=0`**.  In `restr_object_in_place`
# (screstrs.cpp) the `var3 == 0` arm of case 0/6 does not test a room at all:
# it tests `position == OBJ_HIDDEN`.  The doubloons start hidden and T81 (the
# zombie shot) moves them **onto** the corpse (`ACT type=0 v1=14 v2=3 v3=1` =
# onto surface 0), so from the moment they become obtainable they are no
# longer hidden and T109 can never pass.  Leaving them hidden -- i.e. never
# shooting the zombie -- does score the +10, but forfeits T81's +20, so that
# trade is 10 points worse.  145 is the ceiling, and this route reaches it.
# Compare the +2 stranded behind an EndGame action in
# `threemonkeys_solution.txt`.
#
# THE SCORE TABLE.  Sixteen `ACT type=4` in the file, and that is all of it:
#   T21  give poisoned cheese to rats        room 13   +5
#   T27  throw molotov                       room 17   +5
#   T36  pour bleach on monster              (any)     +5
#   T40  blow whistle                        room 27   +5
#   T49  pour weedkiller on plant            room 11   +5
#   T54  pour holy water on skeleton         room 28  +20
#   T81  fire blunderbuss  (at the zombie)   (any)    +20
#   T101-T109  one treasure delivered to room 35     9 x +10
# 25 + 40 + 90 = 155; T109's +10 is unreachable, so 65 + 80 = 145.
#
# HOW THE ENDING FIRES.  T110 `* drive *` (room 29, the Driveway) does three
# things: moves the player to room 35, moves **all held objects** (`ACT type=0
# v1=0` = all held) to room 35, and moves the car there.  The treasures do NOT
# have to be put in the car -- carrying them is enough.  EVENTS 25-33 are
# `starter=3 startTask=111` (1-based -> T110) with `time1=time2=1`, so the
# nine scoring tasks run on the turn AFTER `drive`; EVENT 43 [Delay] runs T120
# `Finish` (the file's only `ACT type=6`, v1=0 = win) on that same turn.  So
# the route needs one real turn after `drive` -- here a `wait`.
# WINTEXT is non-empty, so `Congratulations!` is suppressed and the
# transcript ends on the game's own text -- the harness marker.
#
# CAPACITY IS EXACTLY 10 OBJECTS.  The endgame inventory has to be the nine
# treasures plus the torch, so the solver drops every tool the moment it is
# spent: the hook after `open hatch`, the bible after `bless water`, the
# whistle after the bats, the holy water after the skeleton, the plunger after
# the toilet, the iron key after the Wine Cellar door, the sledge hammer after
# `break wall` and the blunderbuss after the shot.
#
# *** ORDER TRAP 1: THE GHOST ROBBERY, AND WHY THE ROUTE STARTS OUTDOORS. ***
# T48 `GHOST MOVING STUFF` is `rep=0`, gated on `RESTR type=3 v1=6` (the ghost
# is in the player's room) and its action is `ACT type=0 v1=0 v2=1 v3=1` --
# move ALL HELD to a random room of group 1.  It fires exactly once, whenever
# you first share a room with the wandering ghost, so the route spends it
# deliberately and immediately: `drop torch` on the Porch, then chase the
# ghost empty-handed (JUDYTRACE npc=4) until "A strange chill fills the air.",
# then walk back for the torch.  It has to be the Porch or another outdoor
# room -- rooms 1-28 and 30 are dark without the torch (T94 and the room ALTs,
# `hide=1`), and a dark room hides its objects from `take`, so a torch dropped
# indoors can never be picked up again.
#
# *** ORDER TRAP 2: THE MOLOTOV HAS AN 8-TURN FUSE. ***
# `light molotov` (the Kitchen hob, room 9) starts EVENT 1, which runs T26
# `KILLED BY MOLOTOV` (a death) if you are still holding it when it expires.
# The walk from the Kitchen to the Toy Room (9 -> 5 -> 4 -> 1 -> 15 -> 17) is
# five moves, so `throw molotov` on the sixth turn is the whole margin.  The
# solver lights it only once the cloth-and-vodka cocktail is already made and
# walks straight there.
#
# *** ORDER TRAP 3: DO NOT WASTE THE LOADED BLUNDERBUSS. ***
# `* fire * blunderbuss *` matches seven tasks.  T81 is the one worth +20 and
# it is restricted on `RESTR type=3 v1=0 v2=0 v3=8` (the zombie present), but
# it does NOT out-rank the others by room:
#   T70 / T76  room 11 (Conservatory) -- NO NPC restriction at all, so firing
#              anywhere in the Conservatory silently burns the shot;
#   T77  room 13 while the rats live, T78  room 27 while the bats live --
#              both shadow T81;
#   T74 / T79 / T80  need T85/T86 `hit door with hammer`, never done here.
# So the solver shoots the zombie first, before anything else, and simply
# refuses to fire in rooms 11, 13 and 27.
#
# *** ORDER TRAP 4: HEALTH IS A FOUR-POINT BUDGET. ***
# VAR 0 `health` starts at 4 and T97 `ARE YOU DEAD` ends the game the moment
# it reaches 0.  Two things spend it.  T32-T35 answer *any* `take` in the Toy
# Room, Bathroom, Attic and Conservatory with a mauling (-1) while the puppet,
# the slime monster, the bats and the plant live -- which is also why an
# object scattered into one of those rooms is out of reach until its guardian
# is dead.  And T95 `ZOMBIE ATTACK`, run by NPC 6's walk whenever it catches
# up with the player, costs another point whenever VAR 4 `luck` rolls 1.
# Shooting the zombie does NOT stop this: NPC 6 has `stopTask=0`, so the
# corpse keeps stumbling into you for the rest of the game.  The solver
# therefore steers each step around the zombie's current room, and holds the
# first aid kit (T124 `use kit` sets health back to 4, once) as its one spare
# life.
#
# *** ORDER TRAP 5: THE CONSERVATORY REFUSES TO GIVE UP ANYTHING. ***
# T35 blocks `take` in room 11 until T49 (`pour weedkiller on plant`) is done.
# The weedkiller is behind the iron-locked Wine Cellar door, which is behind
# the rats.  So the cheese chain gates the plant, which gates the Conservatory
# and the Garden beyond it -- and if this seed scattered something needed
# earlier into room 11, that seed is simply unsolvable.
#
# THE PUZZLE CHAIN, in dependency order (rooms are fixed, the objects are not):
#   open door (Porch)                      -> scatters the whole house
#   hook -> open hatch (21)                -> Attic 27
#   cheese + poison -> poison cheese, which also yields THE BOTTLE
#     -> give poisoned cheese to rats (13) (+5) and unblocks 13 -> 14
#   bottle -> turn tap / fill bottle (Toilet 6) -> water
#   bible -> bless water                   -> holy water
#   iron key -> unlock door (Wine Cellar 13) -> Laboratory 14
#   weedkiller -> pour weedkiller on plant (11) (+5), which opens 11 <-> 31
#     Garden -> Shed 32 and Vegetable Patch 33
#   vodka + dish cloth -> use vodka with cloth -> cocktail
#     -> light molotov (Kitchen hob) -> throw molotov (Toy Room 17) (+5)
#   whistle -> blow whistle (Attic 27) (+5)
#   sledge hammer -> break wall (Attic) -> Hidden Room 28: holy water on the
#     skeleton (+20)
#   bleach -> pour bleach on monster (from Hallway<3> 19) (+5) -> Bathroom 20
#     -> unblock toilet with the plunger -> the gold bar
#   say live (Lounge 3) -> the blunderbuss appears in the fireplace;
#     ball (on the snooker table, Games 16) -> put ball in blunderbuss
#     -> fire blunderbuss at the zombie (+20), whose corpse carries the bag of
#     doubloons
#
# THE MAP (from the EXIT table).  `*` = gated.
#   29 Driveway -N- 0 Porch -N- 1 Entrance Hall
#   1: N->4  E->3 Lounge  W->2 Music  U->15 Landing
#   3 Lounge: N->7 Dinning
#   4 Hallway<1>: N->5  E->7  W->6 Toilet
#   5 Hallway<2>: N->11 Conservatory  E->9 Kitchen  W->8 Library
#   8 Library: N->10 Study (brass-key locked; EMPTY)
#   9 Kitchen: N->12 Meat Locker  S->7  D->13 Wine Cellar
#   11 Conservatory: N->31 Garden *T52 (until the plant dies)
#   13 Wine Cellar: S->14 Laboratory *iron key AND *T13 (rats)  U->9
#                   IN->30 Hole *T7 dig (EMPTY)
#   31 Garden: E->33 Veg Patch  W->32 Shed  S->11
#   33 Veg Patch: U->34 Ledge;  34 Ledge: S->26 En Suite *T3  D->33
#   15 Landing: N->19  E->17 Toy  W->16 Games  D->1
#   19 Hallway<3>: N->21  E->20 Bathroom *T82 (until the monster dies)
#                  W->18 Guest<1>;   18: N->22 Guest<2>
#   21 Hallway<4>: N->24 Master  E->23 Spare  W->22  U->27 Attic *T5 hatch
#   23 Spare: S->20 *T83
#   24 Master: E->26 En Suite  W->25 Walk in Closet
#   26 En Suite: N->34 Ledge *T3 (open window)
#   27 Attic: S->28 Hidden Room *T6 break wall  D->21
# The Study (10) and the Hole (30) hold nothing at any seed, so the brass key,
# the shovel and `dig dirt` are all optional and are skipped.
